description: This file defines a PHP class 'PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams' that extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate search filter parameters for performance tracking, including sorting capabilities and employee number filtering within a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for filtering and sorting performance tracker search results, including employee number and predefined sortable fields.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, which can be an integer or null.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
